Select the first 500 activity measurements for monoamine oxidase B (CHEMBL221). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL221. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, and standard_units. Rank rows by potency (ascending standard_value) and limit to 500.
